subject.title: fix(cron): support current and session: targets in initial delivery resolution

question: Should `current` and `session:<id>` cron jobs store implicit announce delivery, despite the current isolated-only documented default?
rationale: This is a user-visible delivery-default and compatibility decision, not a mechanical consistency repair, because runtime inference already exists while persistence changes job configuration semantics.

options.title: Keep isolated-only initialization
options.body: Remove the persistent-target branches and preserve runtime inference without storing announce as explicit job configuration.

options.title: Approve the broader default
options.body: Intentionally broaden the contract, update the documentation, and require fresh-install, upgrade, routing, and duplicate-delivery proof.

options.title: Close this approach
options.body: Close the PR if maintainers do not want persistent-session delivery defaults changed.

recommendation.title: Keep isolated-only initialization
recommendation.body: Remove the persistent-target branches and preserve runtime inference without storing announce as explicit job configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged persistent-session restoration records explicit product approval and is the strongest available ownership signal for this contract.
